name: Matt Wolfe (YouTube)
notes: Tone benchmark. Weekly 'AI News' roundup plus hands-on model tests and tool demos. Some videos are sponsored (#ad) or robotics-themed, so filter those out. Feed holds the latest 15 videos with descriptions.

name: The AI Daily Brief (YouTube)
notes: Daily. Each description gives the main story plus an 'In the headlines' list, which makes it a good story radar. The podcast feed (https://anchor.fm/s/f7cac464/podcast/rss) also works but is about 8 MB with 1,100+ items, so use YouTube.

name: Matthew Berman (YouTube)
notes: Near-daily. Covers model launches with hands-on tests, plus some developer and coding content.

name: Wes Roth (YouTube)
notes: Several videos a week. Titles are hype-heavy (caps, ellipses), so treat it as a signal only and confirm facts elsewhere.

name: The AI Advantage (YouTube)
notes: Practical how-to clips on new ChatGPT and Claude features. Descriptions are mostly promo boilerplate, so the titles carry the signal.

name: Hard Fork (NYT podcast)
notes: Weekly (Fridays, US). The public feed only shows the latest 2 episodes and the show notes list the topics. The podcast is free; NYT articles are paywalled.

name: The Rundown AI
notes: Daily newsletter. The feed carries only the headline and a 'PLUS' teaser, with no body text.

name: Ben's Bites
notes: 2-3 issues a week with full text in the feed (Substack). Written from a builder/startup angle.

name: The Neuron
notes: Daily with full text in the feed (beehiiv). Plain-English explainers; the closest match to the target tone.

name: Last Week in AI
notes: Weekly digest plus podcast posts, full text (Substack). Useful as a weekly catch-up; moderately technical.

name: The Verge (AI)
notes: Several posts a day; the feed holds the 10 latest. Some Verge articles are subscriber-only (JSON-LD marks isAccessibleForFree=false), but news posts were fully readable.

name: TechCrunch (AI)
notes: Many posts a day covering startups, funding and product news. Free. Feed summaries are short and some items are event promos (filter out 'Disrupt' ticket posts).

name: Wired (AI)
notes: About daily. Metered paywall; feed summaries are short.

name: MIT Technology Review (AI)
notes: About one a day. Metered paywall. Analysis and long reads, some of them research-heavy.

name: Ars Technica (AI)
notes: Several a day, free. Strong on legal and policy stories and on sceptical hands-on testing.

name: Engadget (AI)
notes: Consumer-focused and free. The commonly cited /ai/rss.xml returns 404; this category feed is the one that works.

name: The Guardian (AI)
notes: Many a day, free. Strong on policy, work and society, with UK and Australian angles. Includes opinion pieces and the odd non-AI economics story.

name: BBC Technology
notes: Several a day, free. About 60% AI; the rest is general tech, so filter.

name: Fast Company (AI)
notes: Business and leadership angle. Feed summaries are short, and article pages returned 403 to curl, so expect scripted fetches to be blocked. The /technology/rss feed carries full text but is only about 40% AI.

name: CNBC Technology
notes: Business and markets: deals, earnings, funding, IPOs. About 60% AI. CNBC Pro items are paywalled.

name: The Decoder
notes: AI-only news site, quick on model launches and safety stories. Free; the subscription is optional.

name: ABC News (AI topic)
notes: Free, Australian angle, about 80% AI. Topic ID found in the ABC topic page; the feed title just says 'ABC News'. Summaries are short.

name: The Conversation (AI)
notes: Free, full text in the feed, written by academics (many Australian). The /au/ URL redirects to this global topic feed. Articles are Creative Commons licensed.

name: InnovationAus
notes: Daily coverage of Australian tech policy, government and startups. About 40% AI. Paywalled: most stories show only the standfirst and first paragraph to non-subscribers.

name: iTnews
notes: Daily Australian enterprise IT news, about 35% AI, free. Feed summaries are very short. Feed times are labelled +1000 even during daylight saving (the article page shows +11:00), so they run 1 hour late.

name: SmartCompany (Technology)
notes: Written for Australian small business. About 3 tech items a week. Some articles are SmartCompany Plus (paywalled). The tag/artificial-intelligence feed does not exist.

name: Information Age (ACS)
notes: Free Australian tech news, about one a day, often with local pricing and availability. Summaries are very short.

name: National AI Centre (Australian Government)
notes: Official National AI Centre (DISR) feed: SME events, guidance and AI Adoption Tracker posts. Low frequency, about weekly or less. The only working Australian government AI feed found.

name: GamesIndustry.biz
notes: Games business news (deals, layoffs, AI in development). Only about 15% AI, so a keyword filter is needed. 100 items in the feed.

name: The Verge (Gaming)
notes: AI-in-games stories show up here (Xbox Labs, Epic). Use a keyword filter.

name: Variety (AI tag)
notes: Film, TV and music AI stories, a few a week. Some VIP+ articles are paywalled.

name: Deadline (AI tag)
notes: Hollywood and media AI, about 2 a week. Includes some listicles and galleries.

name: OpenAI News
notes: Official. Many posts are customer case studies, so prioritise product, model and policy posts. Article pages return 403 to curl. Large feed (1,293 items, about 790 KB).

name: Anthropic News (unofficial mirror)
notes: Anthropic has no official RSS (anthropic.com/rss.xml returns 404). This community-maintained GitHub feed (Olshansk/rss-feeds) scrapes anthropic.com/news and could break without notice, so monitor it.

name: Google Keyword (AI)
notes: Official Google product and model announcements. The old /technology/ai/rss/ URL redirects here.

name: Google DeepMind blog
notes: Official model launches plus research. The feed carries titles only. Skip pure research and robotics posts.

name: Meta Newsroom
notes: Official. About 25% AI (Muse models, Meta AI features, small-business tools). ai.meta.com/blog/rss/ returns HTTP 400.

name: Official Microsoft Blog
notes: Big Microsoft and Copilot announcements, about weekly, full text. The old AI blog feed (blogs.microsoft.com/ai/feed/) returns 410 Gone. Microsoft Source (https://news.microsoft.com/source/feed/) is a busier alternative.

name: Mistral AI news
notes: Official. Low frequency (2 posts in 21 days); last post was Mistral Large 4 on 6 Oct. Not weekly, but it's the only official launch signal for Mistral.

name: Apple Newsroom
notes: Official, about one a day. Only AI-relevant when Apple Intelligence or Siri AI is involved, so filter.
